description: Before your agent buys a Base token: can it sell it back? A simulated buy and immediate sale on the deepest pool (honeypot and tax detection, Uniswap v4 hooks included), real sales on that pool, owner and admin powers, real liquidity. No address: the free sample. An address: its price ($0.01 over x402) and how to pay; `addresses` (up to 10): one call, priced per token.
name: check_token
